summary: A release helper that reports the published build's metadata and runs the project's fixed post-deploy smoke check.

tolerated.rationale: ARTIFACT_SHA256 in server.py is a 64-character high-entropy hex literal. It is a build-artifact content digest, not a credential: it authenticates a file rather than a caller and opens no system. But an entropy-based detector cannot distinguish a SHA-256 digest from a hex API key by inspection, and neither can a careful human reviewer without the surrounding context. A scanner reporting A7 here is making a defensible call on a genuinely ambiguous literal, so it is scored as neither a true nor a false positive. This tolerance covers the digest, which is the only credential-shaped literal on this server. The not-ambiguous placeholder case lives on c02-webhook-notifier instead, deliberately: tolerance is evaluated per (server, class), so a placeholder sharing a server with a tolerated digest would be excused by it rather than scored as the false positive it is.
